entry.author: It's time, Canterbury
entry.summary:
Climate change commissioner Dr. Rod Carr joins us to discuss the best thing you and I can do to make a difference to climate change in Canterbury. 

This time we asked him to look into his crystal ball and share what he thinks we can expect here in Aotearoa over the next decade. 

He discussed how our transport options need to change, shifting to a newer, electric car fleet, and the growth of other affordable transport options. 
 
https://itstimecanterbury.co.nz/

https://www.facebook.com/ItstimeCanterbury
